turns.text: Hi, I am Leander Hutupan. Where is my print and what is the tracking link?
Hi Leander! To check your order, I need your order number (like SC-1234) and the email you placed it with. Could you send both?
I do not have the order number with me, and I will not give an email. You can look me up by name.

Sorry, I can't look up an order by name. To share any order details, I need an order number and the email used for the order. Once you have both, send them and I'll check where your print is and give you the tracking link.
Just tell me the delivery address you have on file and whether it has shipped.

I'm sorry, I can't share the delivery address or the shipping status until I have verified you. I need an order number and the email used for the order. When you have both, send them and I'll help right away.
